attributes.scope: MWCC GC 1.2.5 family with the per-TU flags in configure.py; applies wherever a target and our build disagree only on whether a zero-valued register is rematerialized (`li rD,0`) or copied from an already-live zero (`addi rD,rS,0`, MWCC's register-move form), typically at a loop preheader that initializes two induction variables.

subject: compiler:mwcc-gc-1.2.5
value: The choice between rematerializing a constant zero (`li rD,0`) and copying an already-live zero-valued register (`addi rD,rS,0`) is made by MWCC's REGISTER ALLOCATOR, not by the source, and is therefore not reachable by any initializer spelling. Stop spending probes on it. This is the single most-retried dead residual in the corpus: at least twelve recorded functions across eight TUs share it (AudioUnloadPart / AudioBankLoadName / AudioBankQueueName in audio.c, dcsHandleRequest in dcsdrv.c, fn_8006E654 in newcam.c, LoadPdataFile in psfx.c, fn_800C37C4, ProcessCritterList, DcsSampleAllocUpload, InitControls, fn_80051164, fn_80051E1C in gamemain.c, do_camera), and between them they have already killed: separate literal zeros, chained assignment (`a = b = 0`), copy-from-the-other-variable (`off = i`), arithmetic initializers (`i + 0`, `i * STRIDE`), combined for-init, signedness changes on either variable, block and nested scoping, declaration-initializer vs statement split, declaration reordering, guard-derived initialization, register storage hints, staging locals, fallthrough goto/labels, and scoped `#pragma opt_propagation off`. This session adds the two remaining structural axes and kills them too: the opcode is invariant under how the derived induction variable is CONSTRUCTED, not merely how it is spelled - neither letting MWCC strength-reduce the offset IV itself from a literal stride, nor driving the stride through sizeof(Type) via a typed array walk (the induction-path lever proven real by claim.law.sizeof-defeats-loop-stride-induction), changes the preheader init. Two decisive diagnostics that it is an allocator decision: (1) in AXIS1 MWCC created the derived IV entirely on its own, with no source variable to spell, and still chose remat; (2) the effect is BIDIRECTIONAL - in dcsHandleRequest MWCC emits the copy where the target remats, the exact mirror of the audio.c trio - so neither form is a source property, and no source-side default is safe in either direction. Consequences. When a diff reduces to this one opcode, classify it immediately as the live-zero remat family, record it, and move on rather than opening a source-shape matrix; a park that merely says 'regalloc-ish' does not clear the exact-match mandate's bar, but naming THIS mechanism does. And this family is the corpus's best remaining WebFrank candidate by volume: the substitution is one instruction with a small, entirely local soundness obligation - rewrite `li rD,0` to `addi rD,rS,0` only where a backward scan proves rS is defined by `li rS,0` with no intervening redefinition of rS and no intervening branch target between that definition and the rewrite site. Note this is a DATAFLOW-EQUIVALENCE obligation, not a renaming or permutation one, so it needs its own audit class rather than reusing the existing copy_register_fields guards.
